root_cause.text: In qla2xxx, the error paths in qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb() manually freed the fcport even though kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release) already invoked sp->free = qla2x00_els_dcmd_sp_free(), which also frees the same fcport, causing a double free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states that qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb() sets sp->free to qla2x00_els_dcmd_sp_free() and that on error this is called via qla2x00_sp_release() from kref_put(), while the patch removes both direct qla2x00_free_fcport(fcport); calls immediately after kref_put() in qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb().

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove erroneous fcport deallocation from the ELS LOGO payload failure path to avoid freeing an object still owned elsewhere.
intent_record.what: The change removes the call to qla2x00_free_fcport(fcport) from the error path taken when elsio->u.els_logo.els_logo_pyld allocation/check fails, leaving only kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release) before returning QLA_FUNCTION_FAILED.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this stops the function from explicitly freeing fcport in that failure case, so cleanup is deferred to existing reference-counted or higher-level ownership logic instead of releasing fcport immediately. This prevents incorrect deallocation of fcport on this path, which could otherwise lead to use-after-free, double free, or ownership mismatches.

intent_record.intent_summary: Stop freeing fcport on qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb() failure to avoid an incorrect or duplicate release in the error path.
intent_record.what: The change removes the call to qla2x00_free_fcport(fcport) from the error-handling path in qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb() when rval != QLA_SUCCESS, leaving only kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release) before returning QLA_FUNCTION_FAILED.
intent_record.how: At runtime, a failed IOCB setup no longer explicitly frees fcport in this branch, preventing that object from being released here and avoiding a likely incorrect or duplicate free while still dropping the command reference.

candidates.rationale: This explicit free in the error path duplicates the fcport deallocation already triggered indirectly by kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release), causing the double free described in the root cause.
This manual fcport free after kref_put on IOCB setup/dispatch failure releases the same object a second time, since the release path already frees fcport via qla2x00_els_dcmd_sp_free().

vuln_statements.explanation: This manual free in qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb()'s error path releases fcport even though the preceding kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release) already leads to qla2x00_els_dcmd_sp_free(), which frees the same fcport. That duplicated deallocation is the direct cause of the double free.

bic_trace_step.reason: The diff is sufficient because it shows both the freeing callback and the relevant error/success paths in qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb(). The root cause is a double free where qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb() manually frees fcport even though kref_put(&sp->cmd_kref, qla2x00_sp_release) leads to sp cleanup that also frees sp->fcport. In this commit, the callback qla2x00_els_dcmd_sp_free() still frees the fcport via `if (sp->fcport) qla2x00_free_fcport(sp->fcport);`, so ownership is clearly in the SP release path. In qla24xx_els_dcmd_iocb(), the manual free after completion was removed: the line `qla2x00_free_fcport(fcport);` after `wait_for_completion(&elsio->u.els_logo.comp);` is deleted, which eliminates the double free on the normal path. The remaining added free is only in the allocation-failure path `if (!elsio->u.els_logo.els_logo_pyld) { kref_put(...); qla2x00_free_fcport(fcport); return ...; }`, which is consistent with the commit message and indicates the object is freed there only because the SP release path at that point does not own/free that external fcport in the same problematic way for that path. Therefore the vulnerable construct—manual free on the path where SP release also frees fcport—is absent, and the fix is present.
